what.text: This page follows refugees from Kenya living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1320 Kenyan refugees in the United States, 9.9% of all refugees from Kenya.
Ethiopia hosts the most Kenyan refugees, followed by Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Northeastern Province and Coast territory in Kenya with Al-Shabaab in every year from 2015 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2006 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 41 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 2551, at the end of 2011, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
